artworks.title: Josephus Justus Scaliger
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 27.5 x 19.8 cm (10 13/16 x 7 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a man in a richly detailed oval frame. The man has a serious expression, short hair, a mustache, and a goatee. The frame includes allegorical figures, cherubs, architectural elements, fruits, and floral decorations. Cherubs above the portrait appear to hold objects. Latin text is displayed below the portrait.

artworks.title: Julius Caesar Scaliger
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the chest up. He faces the right with a slight angle, showing his profile. The man has a prominent nose, high forehead, deeply set eyes, a full beard and mustache. His thinning hair is pulled back. He wears Renaissance clothing, including a doublet and draped cloak. The background has a dense pattern. Below the portrait, there is a text panel with Latin script.

artworks.title: Daniel Schnabel
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up, facing the left. He has an aged face with distinct features including a pronounced nose, visible forehead lines, a mustache, and a pointed chin beard. His shoulder-length, wavy hair appears thinning. He wears a garment with a large lace-trimmed collar and an elaborately patterned sash. The background includes an oval frame with an intricate border, text, and a coat of arms at the bottom.

artworks.title: Anna Maria van Schurman
artworks.artist: Theodor Matham, after Anna Maria van Schurman
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright. The individual is turned slightly to the right, looking directly at the viewer with a composed expression. They have medium-length, wavy hair, delicate features, and are dressed in elaborate attire with intricate details. They wear a bracelet on their right wrist and hold a circular pendant in their right hand. In the background, there is a heavy drapery to the right and a window to the left showing a structure outside. A small table beneath the window holds an open book and scattered papers.

artworks.title: Anna Maria van Schurman
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a woman from the waist up. She is facing forward with long curly hair falling past her shoulders. The woman's facial features include a distinct nose, almond-shaped eyes, and slightly arched eyebrows. She is dressed in a dark, intricately patterned garment with a ruffled collar and an embroidered detail on the chest. She wears a light-colored shawl or cape around her shoulders. The frame of the image includes floral and leaf designs, with the inscription "AN. MARIA VAN SCHURMAN" visible.

artworks.title: Anna Maria van Schurman
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a person facing forward. They have delicate facial features with a slight smile, and curly hair flowing past their shoulders. The person is dressed in a formal garment with a lace collar and structured bodice. The background features an ornate frame with decorative elements and Latin script.

artworks.title: Anna Maria van Schurman
artworks.description: This is an illustrated portrait showing the upper half of a woman's body within an ornate oval frame. The woman is positioned facing slightly to the right, with her head turned to face forward. She has long curly hair that frames her face and delicate facial features, including wide eyes and a subtle smile. She is dressed in a dark, patterned gown with a lace collar and a decorative brooch at her chest. The background features intricate foliage and decorative elements, with text that reads "ANNA MARIA VAN SCHVR" encircling the frame. Beneath the portrait, there are several lines of script text, accompanied by the artist's signature, "C. Boÿ". The overall aesthetic of the image combines detailed line work and classical style.

artworks.title: Anna Maria van Schurman
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with long, wavy hair and light-colored eyes. They are wearing a high-collared garment with lace details and a large white collar. The individual is in an oval frame against a textured brickwork background. Below the portrait is italic handwriting text.

artworks.title: Anna Maria van Schurman
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman. She is facing forward, displaying her head, shoulders, and upper torso. Her expression is serious, with large, focused eyes. Her hair is styled away from her face, possibly tied back or under a cap, with curls resting on her neck. She is wearing a historical costume with a dress featuring a tied crisscross pattern at the bodice, a lace collar, and a bow at the neck. An ornate border surrounds the portrait with the text "ANNA MARIA A SCHURMAN" around the oval frame. The background is shaded, contrasting with the lighter tones of the woman's attire and face.

artworks.title: Christopher Schwaiger
artworks.description: This image is a portrait depicting a man's upper body. The man faces forward with his head slightly turned to his right. He has curly, graying hair, a mustache, and a beard. He wears a formal 16th-century outfit with a high, ruffled collar and a doublet. The background features a circular pattern with text surrounding the man's head that reads "CHRISTOPH SCHWAIGER" and "AN. M.D.C. SE. LXVIII." Below the portrait, there is text in Latin and the engraver's name, Lucas Kilian.

artworks.title: Gaspar Scioppi
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man with distinct facial features including a mustache and goatee. He is wearing a doublet with a high collar and long sleeves, typical of early 17th-century fashion. The man's right hand is on a table, and his left hand appears to be holding a folded paper. On the table is an illustration of a small hedgehog. The background is plain, and there is Latin text inscribed above and below the portrait.

artworks.title: Andrew Scott, Jesuit Missionary
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with a slight turn to his body, facing forward but with his gaze directed slightly to the side. He has detailed facial features, with a mustache and short, neatly trimmed hair. He wears a cap, a formal garment with a high collar, and holds a small book in his right hand. The background consists of horizontal lines, creating a textured appearance. Below the portrait, there is a block of text providing additional context.

artworks.title: Thomas Scott, Geographer and Theologian
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man identified as Thomas Scotus. He is depicted looking slightly to the left with a contemplative expression. He has a furrowed forehead, defined cheekbones, a straight nose, a short beard, and a moustache. His hair is cropped on the sides and slightly receding on top. He wears a pleated ruff around his neck and intricately fastened clothing typical of the time period. The border of the engraving is ornate with floral elements and Latin script indicating his identity. The background has a textured, hatched surface.

artworks.title: Thomas Scott, Geographer and Theologian
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man, from the chest up. He is slightly turned, facing forward with his gaze towards the viewer. The man has a high forehead with a prominent widows peak, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a small beard and mustache. His hair is short and dark. He wears a high-collared historical garment with a detailed ruff collar. The background contains a decorative frame with floral designs and elements suggesting a classical or heraldic motif. The text surrounding the portrait identifies the man as Thomas Scotus and references his involvement in theology and geography.

artworks.title: Petrus Scriverius
artworks.description: This image is an engraving of Petrus Scriverius, a man depicted from the upper half. He is facing slightly to the left, making direct eye contact with the viewer. He has a distinctive head shape, a high forehead, short beard and mustache, and neatly styled short hair. He wears period clothing with a detailed garment and an elaborate ruffled collar. The portrait is set within an oval frame with fine linear detailing in the background. Surrounding the oval are inscriptions that include "LEGENDE ET SCRIBENDO" at the top and "PETRUS SCRIVERIUS" below the image.

artworks.title: Peter Scriverius, Dutch Historian
artworks.artist: Cornelis Visscher after Pieter Claesz Soutman
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the head and upper body of an elderly man seated in a front-facing position. His facial features include a prominent nose, bushy eyebrows, and a long mustache that extends downward merging into a full beard. His hair is long and appears to be white, peeking out from under a broad-brimmed dark hat. He is dressed in a dark cloak with a large collar and buttons running down the front. The man holds a book in his hands, resting it on his lap. The background is a plain, intricately crosshatched texture, surrounded by an adorned frame with Latin text above and below the portrait.

artworks.title: Sebastian, King of Portugal
artworks.description: The image shows a young person facing the viewer from the waist up. One hand is over the chest while the other holds an object. They have short hair and fine facial features. The individual is wearing an intricately designed garment with a high collar and detailed shoulders. There is jewelry around their neck. The background has a draped curtain and an armillary sphere and a closed book with a cross on it on a table beside them. The oval frame contains inscriptions.

artworks.title: Sebastian, King of Portugal
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a young person from the waist up, facing forward. The individual has short, closely cropped hair, a smooth complexion, and a composed expression. They wear a detailed garment, possibly a robe, with puffed sleeves and intricate embroidery on the chest and collar. A thick necklace is around their neck, and a bracelet is on their wrist. The person's left hand is resting over their chest, and their right hand appears to hold a scepter or similar object. An armillary sphere is nearby on a table. The figure is set against a draped fabric background within an oval frame with text.

artworks.title: Daniel Segers, Jesuit Priest
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of the upper half of a man in profile, facing left. He is standing upright, holding a sheet with floral designs in front of him. The man has mature features, including a receding hairline, closely cropped curly hair, angular facial features, a prominent nose, and light facial hair. He is wearing a dark, high-collared robe. In the background, there is a wall, foliage, and a vine with leaves and flowers. An inscription is located below the figure.

artworks.title: John Selden, Jurist and Antiquary
artworks.artist: Robert Hart after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man from the chest up, in a semi-profile view, looking slightly to his right. He has long, wavy hair that extends past his shoulders, prominent facial features, and is wearing a dark cloak with a visible white collar. The circular engraving is centered on a larger rectangular paper with a border. Below the image, there is text including the name "Selden" and publishing details. The background of the frame is plain with some discolored spots on the paper around the engraving.

artworks.title: John Selden, Jurist and Antiquary
artworks.artist: William Holl I or William Holl II, after Daniel Mytens the Elder
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a seated male figure, identified as John Selden. The man is positioned three-quarters to the viewer's right, with his right hand resting on his lap and the left hand relaxed to the side. He has distinguishable facial features with a mustache and goatee, long wavy hair flowing past his shoulders, and is wearing a dark, formal outfit with a high white collar. There is no visible jewelry or accessories. The background is plain. The image is presented within a bordered frame and contains an inscription indicating its origin from Mytens in The Bodleian Gallery, Oxford.

artworks.title: John Selden, Jurist and Antiquary
artworks.artist: Robert Cooper, after Daniel Mytens the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man with long, wavy hair and a narrow mustache. He is seated and facing slightly to the left, looking directly at the viewer. He wears a dark, formal outfit with a white collar. One hand holds the edge of his jacket, while the other rests on his leg. The background is plain and dark, with the portrait set against a cream-colored speckled mat that has the name "Selden" written below the engraving.

artworks.title: John Selden, Jurist and Antiquary
artworks.artist: Robert Cooper, after Daniel Mytens the Elder
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man sitting down. The man has long, wavy hair, a thick moustache with a small goatee, and a serious expression. He is wearing a dark, doublet-like garment with large cuffed sleeves and a white collar. The background is dark, and the outer section of the image contains text on a light-colored surface with faded spots.

artworks.title: John Selden, Esquire, Jurist and Antiquary
artworks.artist: Samuel Freeman after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man from the chest up. The man is facing slightly to the right, with long, dark wavy hair and distinguishable facial features. He wears a dark cloak or robe with a white shirt visible underneath. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is a plain, light-colored surface. The border around the oval portrait includes additional text with the man's name and details about the engraving.
